- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
f- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.

v- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
a- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

a- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
v- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

)- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
,- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
a- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).

(- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
i- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

s- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
S- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

t- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
e- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
p- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.

i- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
;- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
r- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

a- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
,- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

e- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
.- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
n- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.

a- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
u- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
o- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).

l- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
n- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

l- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
z- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
n- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

t- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
n- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
f- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

t- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
r- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

a- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
o- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

)- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
9- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

,- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

`- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
e- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
s- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

s- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
i- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
6- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

h- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
|- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).

-- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
1- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
s- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

6- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
p- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

|- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
p- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
3- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
n- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
h- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

h- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
p- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).

 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
e- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
r- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.

h- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.

/- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
,- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

- **Checkpoint / resume**: `Dirt.checkpoint()` snapshots biome, fill, phase and the soil profile mid-run; `Dirt.resume(data)` rebuilds the pile and continues (throwing, or growing on the settled dirt).
- **Groundcover**: tufts and clover over the dirt in every biome except desert and meadow.
- **Settled start**: `settled: true` builds the pile instantly from a gently bumpy profile at the fill line and skips the throw; with `flora: 'none'` that is the spill-over the extension puts on the pages after a buried one.
r- **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.

 - **Feel** (0.3): the shoveller stands off the left or right edge; each big shovelful (150–450 grains) enters just above the dirt at that edge and lobs to the lowest point of the pile on an arc that is checked to clear the terrain first. Clumps hold together in the air and skid sideways on impact (never upward); nothing settles more than 12 % of the height above the fill line. Three slide rules in the sand automaton: 45° diagonal, a sideways step on a two-cell drop (more often above the fill line), and a rare one-cell step on the surface that rounds the humps. The simulation ticks at `simHz` (default 30) under a 60 fps render.
